title: Never Broke Us
lines: Even when the fridge bare, frost all over
We still step clean, head high, stay focused
Had nothing, but we turned out something, now the door bust open
Brixton never broke us (Tell them again)
Yeah, ice in the veins now
Hood still love when the mandem roll up
From flats to the stage, same block that grow us
Had nothing, but we turned out something now, now the door bust open
